summary: Magnolia Oil & Gas closed its purchase of WildFire Intermediate Holdings from WildFire Energy I LLC on September 10, 2026, after a July 20, 2026 purchase agreement. Consideration totaled $2,570 million cash, 32,203,000 Magnolia Class A shares, and assumption of Target's $600 million 7.500% senior notes due 2029. Immediately post-close, Target merged into Magnolia's operating subsidiary, which assumed the notes via supplemental indenture. The 8-K also reports a direct financial obligation, unregistered equity issuance, and Regulation FD disclosure. Watch integration, leverage, note covenants, and any share overhang from the equity issuance.
